note: CPW campground on the Arkansas River a few miles north of Buena Vista, by the historic railroad bridge; a river access and boat slide for paddlers and gold-panners, near some of the area's best-known climbing. Two RV sites (1407, 1408) sit on the riverbank. Avoid GPS routes that send large rigs through the low-clearance railroad tunnels. --Claude
summary: CPW camping + Leadville-Buena Vista section pages, cpwshop park page and site pages: confirmed $28 basic (+ vehicle pass), vault toilets, no potable water, reservable on cpwshop. Added hookups none, sites 14 (8 drive-in 38-60 ft, 3 pull-through, 6 hike-in tent), season year-round, booking window 180 days, fcfs never, booking.season year-round. Note: dropped the '~21 drive-in sites' (CPW says 14, 8 drive-in) and 'Reservable Apr-Oct' (cpwshop: open and bookable year round); restated facts moved to fields.
flags: Waterfront (stored not waterfront): cpwshop tags sites 1407 and 1408 'Proximity to Water: Riverfront' (1408 'Location Rating: Prime'). An operator water claim contrary to ours -> re-audit lead. On Esri imagery both sit on the NW edge of the loop about 40-50 m from the Arkansas River channel, with a band of conifers/riparian trees between them and the water, so an open apron is not visible from above; the other six RV sites are 80-150 m back behind the railroad grade. Possible riverfront for 2 of 8 sites; needs the gate.

Site count: CPW says '14 basic sites'; only 8 are drive-in RV sites (1401-1408), the other 6 (1409-1414) are hike-in tent-only. Recorded count 14 with that split in sites.note; the stored note's '~21 drive-in sites' was wrong.

Season: stored note said 'Reservable Apr-Oct'; cpwshop shows the park open year round with a Jan 1-Dec 31 peak season for 2026 and 2027, and the park page says 'Open 24 hours a day, year-round'. That is park-wide (cpwshop lists the AHRA loops under one facility), not a Railroad Bridge-specific statement.
Pin: stored 38.9227,-106.1697 is about 50 m east of the centroid of the six GIS-tagged RV sites (38.92278,-106.17024), inside the campground loop. Fine.
Phone 719-539-7289 confirmed (AHRA contact; also on cpwshop). Reservations 1-800-244-5613.

Max stay: AHRA states 14 days in any 28-day period for DISPERSED camping only; no developed-campground limit read on these pages, so max_stay_nights left unset (CPW statewide rule may come from the agency registry).
Operator: CPW (AHRA is cooperatively managed with BLM and USFS); ownership state correct.
